pretreatments.description: Shredding (I-PT code) - reducing the particle size of the substrates.
Shredding and mixing (II-PT) - homogenizing the organic matter with water addition (10:1 Water content/Total Solids ratio).
Shredding, mixing and blending (III-PT) - a deeper breakdown of fibers, creating a homogeneous liquid slurry.
Mobile hammer mill (Noremat Valormax BA915D) - used for treating cattle manure (M3) at full scale.
Fixed hammer mill - used for treating cattle manure (M4) at full scale.
X-Chopper chain mill (Xergi) - used for treating a mixture of silage and cattle manure (SM) at full scale.
